summary: SK hynix filed a Form 6-K announcing an expanded shareholder return policy, committing to return over 50% of cumulative free cash flow for 2025-2027 and approving an early return of approximately KRW 40 trillion (~$30 billion) through treasury share acquisition and cancellation, citing undervaluation relative to intrinsic value. The board will finalize additional dividend and buyback specifics at Q3 2026 earnings. The policy includes fixed and special dividend review. No advisors named. Watch for board resolutions detailing scale, timing, and execution method, with potential share-price support from buyback activity.
